sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: 売上は前年同期の約5.5倍
headline.en: Revenue reached about 5.5× the prior year

detail.ja: 同じQ2同士の比較。増収率と利益の改善は分けて確認します。
detail.en: This compares the same quarter a year apart; revenue growth and profitability are separate measures.

headline.ja: 調整後EBITDAは黒字へ

detail.ja: 調整後の指標であり、GAAP純利益の黒字化を意味しません。
detail.en: This adjusted measure does not establish GAAP net profitability.

headline.ja: 継続事業では純損失が残る

detail.ja: 前年同期の継続事業純利益は$502.5M。調整後純損失は$91.5Mから$33.2Mへ縮小しており、会計基準による見え方の違いに注意します。
detail.en: Prior-year continuing-operations net income was $502.5M. Adjusted net loss narrowed from $91.5M to $33.2M; keep the accounting bases distinct.

headline.ja: 増収が最終利益につながるか
headline.en: Watch conversion of growth into net profit

points.ja: 次の決算で売上・GAAP損益を照合
points.en: Compare revenue and GAAP earnings next quarter

detail.ja: EBITDAだけで判断せず、設備投資後の資金と最終損益も確認する監視ポイントです。将来の黒字化を保証するものではありません。
detail.en: Research checkpoint: assess cash after capital spending and bottom-line earnings alongside EBITDA, without assuming future profitability.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: 買収・為替を除いても増収
headline.en: Growth extends beyond acquisitions and FX

points.ja: オーガニック売上成長 約18%

detail.ja: 全体の増収率は約24%。買収と為替の寄与を除いた成長率と区別します。
detail.en: Total growth was about 24%; organic growth excludes acquisitions and currency effects.

headline.ja: 調整後営業利益率が改善

detail.ja: 調整後営業利益は$738M、GAAP営業利益は$638M。両者を混同しません。
detail.en: Adjusted operating profit was $738M versus $638M under GAAP.

headline.ja: 供給と工事進行で売上時期にずれ
headline.en: Supply and project execution shifted revenue timing

points.ja: 会社は一時的な供給混雑を説明
points.en: The company described temporary supply-chain congestion

detail.ja: 複数段階のプロジェクト遂行も売上計上時期に影響。需要があっても同じ四半期に売上になるとは限りません。
detail.en: Multi-phase project execution also affected timing; demand need not become revenue in the same quarter.

headline.ja: 次期の納入と利益率を確認

points.ja: Q3調整後営業利益率見通し 24–25%

detail.ja: 売上見通しと合わせて達成状況を確認。予想値であり実績ではありません。
detail.en: Check both sales and margin delivery against company guidance, not as achieved results.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: 受注が売上を上回る規模に

detail.ja: 受注は将来の納入につながる指標で、今期売上に足しません。
detail.en: Orders indicate future delivery activity; they are not added to current-quarter revenue.

headline.ja: 為替などを除く増収は12%

detail.ja: 調整後EBITDAは$1.2B。報告値とオーガニック成長率を区別します。
detail.en: Adjusted EBITDA was $1.2B. Keep reported and organic growth distinct.

headline.ja: 受注残と生産枠は売上とは別
headline.en: Backlog and reserved slots are not revenue

points.ja: ガス発電の受注残＋生産枠予約 116GW
points.en: Gas Power backlog plus slot reservations: 116GW

detail.ja: 予約を完成・納入済みと扱わず、実際の売上化を追う監視ポイントです。
detail.en: Research checkpoint: follow conversion to delivered revenue rather than treating reserved capacity as completed output.

headline.ja: ガスタービンの生産拡大を追う

points.ja: Q3に年産20GWペースを目指す
points.en: Target: 20GW annualized production rate in Q3

detail.ja: 会社目標の進捗と受注残の納入を確認します。目標達成済みとは表示しません。
detail.en: Monitor progress against the company target and delivery of backlog; the target is not an achieved result.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: 製品売上の拡大が中心

points.ja: 製品売上 $935.4M・前年同期比 +215.4%

detail.ja: 全社売上の増収と製品売上の増収を分け、継続性を追います。
detail.en: Track product growth separately from total revenue to assess its durability.

headline.ja: 営業損益と営業キャッシュが改善
headline.en: Operating profit and cash flow improved

detail.ja: 前年同期は営業損失$3.5M。営業キャッシュフローは−$213.1Mから+$226.4Mへ改善しました。
detail.en: The prior-year operating loss was $3.5M. Operating cash flow improved from −$213.1M to +$226.4M.

headline.ja: 生産から設置までの実行を確認
headline.en: Watch execution from production to installation

points.ja: 生産能力・設置・系統接続が確認点

detail.ja: 会社が挙げる将来リスクです。今期に遅延が発生したとの断定ではありません。
detail.en: These are prospective risks identified by the company, not a claim that delays occurred this quarter.

headline.ja: 通期見通しを納入実績と照合

detail.ja: 売上に加え、利益率と営業キャッシュの継続性を追います。
detail.en: Track margins and operating cash generation alongside forecast revenue.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: AIサーバー売上が倍増

detail.ja: AIサーバーの受注残$95Bは未計上の売上と区別します。
detail.en: Keep the $95B AI server backlog separate from recognized revenue.

headline.ja: 通期売上見通しを引き上げ

detail.ja: AIサーバー売上見通しも$60Bから$74Bへ引き上げ。いずれも会社予想です。
detail.en: AI server revenue guidance also rose from $60B to $74B; both are company forecasts.

headline.ja: 増収の一方、営業キャッシュは減少
headline.en: Operating cash flow fell despite growth

detail.ja: 前年同期比13%減。売上や利益の増加だけで資金創出を判断しません。
detail.en: Down 13% year-on-year. Revenue and profit growth alone do not establish stronger cash generation.

headline.ja: 受注を納入・入金まで追う
headline.en: Track orders through delivery and collection

detail.ja: 受注残が実際の売上と営業キャッシュへ転換するかを監視します。
detail.en: Research checkpoint: monitor conversion of backlog into revenue and operating cash.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: クラウドが全社より速く成長

detail.ja: Microsoft Cloudは会社定義の指標で、Azure単独の売上と同じではありません。
detail.en: Microsoft Cloud is a company-defined measure, not Azure revenue alone.

headline.ja: 営業利益も18%増加

detail.ja: 売上と営業利益はともに前年同期比18%増です。
detail.en: Revenue and operating income both increased 18% year-on-year.

headline.ja: EPSには投資益などの押し上げ
headline.en: Investment gains and other items lifted EPS

points.ja: 一部の個別要因によるEPS押し上げ $0.27
points.en: Certain discrete items added $0.27 to EPS

detail.ja: Anthropic投資益などを含みます。non-GAAPが除くOpenAI投資影響とは別で、調整後利益をすべて経常的とは扱いません。
detail.en: These include an Anthropic investment gain, distinct from the OpenAI effects excluded by non-GAAP. Adjusted earnings are not necessarily wholly recurring.

headline.ja: クラウド成長と利益の質を追う
headline.en: Track cloud growth and earnings quality

points.ja: 売上成長・営業利益・投資影響を分ける
points.en: Separate revenue growth, operating profit and investment effects

detail.ja: 次回も同じ会計基準で照合し、一時要因を成長力と混同しないための監視ポイントです。
detail.en: Research checkpoint: compare consistent accounting bases and distinguish discrete gains from operating growth.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: クラウドと検索が成長

points.ja: Cloud +82%・検索など +17%（前年同期比）

detail.ja: Cloudの成長率を全社成長率24%と混同しません。
detail.en: Cloud growth differs from the 24% company-wide revenue increase.

headline.ja: 営業利益率は2ポイント改善

detail.ja: 営業利益率は32%から34%へ上昇。2%増とは異なります。
detail.en: Operating margin moved from 32% to 34%, not a 2% relative increase.

headline.ja: 純利益急増には株式評価益が寄与

detail.ja: 主に株式の未実現利益によるもの。EPSの伸びをそのまま本業の成長率と扱いません。
detail.en: Primarily unrealized equity gains; EPS growth is not equivalent to operating growth.

headline.ja: 投資資金と本業の成長を照合

points.ja: 6月の株式・転換優先株調達 純額$49.6B
points.en: June equity and convertible preferred proceeds: $49.6B net

detail.ja: 追加ATM枠$40Bは6月末時点で未使用。発行済みと発行可能枠を区別して希薄化を追います。
detail.en: The additional $40B ATM program was unused at June-end. Distinguish issued equity from authorized issuance capacity when tracking dilution.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

label.ja: フリーキャッシュフロー

headline.ja: クラウド基盤の売上が倍増超

detail.ja: IaaSとSaaSを合計したクラウド売上は$11.6Bです。
detail.en: Combined IaaS and SaaS revenue was $11.6B.

headline.ja: 営業利益は売上以上の伸び

points.ja: GAAP営業利益 $6.728B・前年同期比 +57%

detail.ja: 売上の30%増と分けて確認します。
detail.en: Compare separately with 30% revenue growth.

headline.ja: 営業CF黒字でも投資後は資金流出

detail.ja: クラウド基盤の投資を継続。Q1には普通株$20Bを売却して資金調達しました。
detail.en: Cloud infrastructure investment continued; Q1 included a $20B common-stock capital raise.

headline.ja: 契約残が売上になる速度を追う

points.ja: RPO $664B・通期売上見通し $90B以上
points.en: RPO $664B; FY revenue guidance at least $90B

detail.ja: RPOは売上計上前の履行義務。設備稼働と売上化、資金負担を合わせて確認します。
detail.en: RPO is not recognized revenue. Monitor capacity delivery, revenue conversion and funding needs together.

sources.title: Official earnings release
sources.location: Financial highlights, financial statements and outlook

headline.ja: 米国の商業・政府とも拡大
headline.en: US commercial and government revenue grew

points.ja: 米国商業 +149%・政府 +90%（前年同期比）

detail.ja: 米国売上は$1.573B。全社売上$1.935Bと分けて見ます。
detail.en: US revenue was $1.573B versus total revenue of $1.935B.

headline.ja: 前四半期からも19%増収

detail.ja: 調整後営業利益$1.194Bには株式報酬などの除外があります。
detail.en: Adjusted operating income of $1.194B excludes stock-based compensation and related payroll taxes.

headline.ja: 契約総額は売上確定額ではない
headline.en: Contract value is not guaranteed revenue

points.ja: 契約オプション・解約条項に注意
points.en: Watch contract options and termination provisions

detail.ja: TCVやRDVはオプション行使と解約なしを前提とする指標。実際の売上計上と区別します。
detail.en: TCV and RDV assume option exercise and no termination; distinguish them from recognized revenue.

headline.ja: 次期成長とGAAP採算を照合
headline.en: Track next-quarter growth and GAAP profitability

detail.ja: 調整後指標だけでなく、GAAP利益と営業キャッシュを継続確認する監視ポイントです。
detail.en: Research checkpoint: assess GAAP earnings and operating cash as well as adjusted metrics.
